title: PRIVATE TOUR HANOI - SAPA - HALONG BAY
route: Halong Bay - Cat Cat Village - Fansipan - Hanoi
source_pdf: Vietnam/Hanoi-Sapa-Halong/Catalog/PT HANOI - SAPA - HALONG BAY 5D4N 2026 v4.pdf

excludes: Luggage, In Flight Meal & Airport Tax

itinerary.title: Fansipan - Cat Cat Village
activities: Train to Cable Car Fansipan Mountain
Cable Car to Fansipan Mountain (world's longest and highest cable car)
Cat Cat Village (H'mong ethnic mountain village)

sub: Gua Sung Sot (largest and most stunning limestone cave)
Titop Island (crescent-moon shaped beach with soft white sand)

itinerary.title: Halong Bay - Hanoi
activities: Mega Grand World Hanoi (the largest entertainment area)
Hanoi Train Street Coffee (taste the local fresh coffee)

expect.title: Long Journey
expect.body: Hanoi to Sapa one way normally takes around 6 to 8 hours depending on traffic.

expect.title: Prepare for Weather
expect.body: Rainy May - October. Sunny November - April.

expect.title: Lots of Walking
expect.body: Some attractions require a lot of walking.

expect.title: Full Board Meals
expect.body: Meals are already included in the package. If you choose not to consume them, no refund will be provided.

expect.title: Check In & Check Out
expect.body: There are a lot of hotel check-ins and check-outs, and into the boat cruise. Please pack efficiently.

expect.title: Luggage Allocation
expect.body: Please bring a maximum of 1 luggage per pax, as it affects car capacity.
